raw:
Seraphel turns the slim, blue-bound book so you can read its worn gilt title: *The Dreary Travels of Amon Vale*.

“An overlong merchant’s travel tale.  
He hates each toll, each bed, each meal;  
which makes his storms feel oddly real.”

She keeps one hand on the back of the empty chair, waiting for your answer to her earlier request.
